preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of strings a and b is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: a and b contain only lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: Both strings a and b consist of lowercase English letters only.

preconditions.expression: Sum of |a| over all queries does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings a across all queries does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: Sum of |b| over all queries does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings b across all queries does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: For each query, if a valid s_i exists, it is printed on a new line
postconditions.description: If a valid palindromic string s_i can be formed by concatenating a non-empty substring of a and a non-empty substring of b, it is printed.

postconditions.expression: If no valid s_i exists, '-1' is printed
postconditions.description: If no valid palindromic string s_i can be formed, '-1' is printed.

postconditions.expression: If multiple valid s_i exist, the first one alphabetically is printed
postconditions.description: If multiple palindromic strings s_i can be formed, the one that comes first alphabetically is printed.
